purpose: CPU pre-fit audit and preregistered sample for short STE-FlowNet GT-supervised fit

training_sample.selection_basis: fixed midpoint 30ms window selected from registered rollout design before reading this window's labels, event counts, or model outputs

independent_validation.selection_basis: entire registered independent validation rollout; no window filtering

audit_contract.flow_unit: forward source-pixel displacement per 30ms endpoint interval
audit_contract.event_active_support: pixels with any event in the official five-bin Gaussian-count representation
audit_contract.texture_threshold: Sobel gradient magnitude of Rec.709 linearized-display-proxy luma > 1/255
audit_contract.warp_direction: sample next endpoint at (x+u,y+v) to compare with previous endpoint at (x,y)
audit_contract.generator_scope: EventGenesis audit only until V2E outputs are manifest-bound to this exact eight-rollout bank; do not mix the older single-rollout smoke V2E artifact
